clues: This big town lies in the north east of a farm rich province in Pakistan. It is a main hub for the towns all around it.
Rain here is rare for most of the year, from October to May. Then the monsoon comes in July and August and brings the most rain.
This town was the capital of a Sikh empire for a short time, from 1799 to 1801. Then the capital moved on to a larger town nearby.
People call this place the town of wrestlers, and it is famed for its food. Strong wrestlers and rich meals are what most folk know it for.
With two towns nearby, this place forms a rich gold triangle of work towns. The three towns sell many goods to lands far away.
